integrity: Proof is analytic; finite matrix computations serve as reproducibility checks, not proof of the limiting statement. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp asymptotic value is for J/Omega tending to infinity and optimization over positive Poisson reset rates; no finite-J global sqrt(5) bound is asserted.
Only the two-spin Hamiltonian with pure joint resets to the doubly-down state and ideal projective CHSH optimization is treated.
The strong-coupling scaling of the stationary state and concurrence are in prior work; novelty assessed for the uniform Bell bound and rate-optimal asymptotics.
Priority uncertainty remains for an inaccessible recent related two-spin analysis.
title: Sharp asymptotic Bell ceiling and reset-rate selection in a two-spin Ising model
